flag_help.--harness: which base harness to start from
flag_help.--sampling: all | below_X | above_X | random_N (chosen on H0)
flag_help.--trials: measure each task N times; the point carries n_trials and score_std
flag_help.--jobs: measure up to N tasks concurrently
flag_help.--mode: DEPRECATED and ignored: there is one engine
flag_help.--improver: improvers/improvers.json name, or a path to an executable
flag_help.--method-entrypoint: argv for the method's own runner
flag_help.--run-id: the run directory name under runs/
flag_help.--tasks: a comma-separated subset of task ids
flag_help.--side: which side of the split this run is about
flag_help.--from-run: --side eval: the train run whose harness state to measure
flag_help.--from-round: --side eval: which round of that run (default: its last)
flag_help.--seed: the environment's seed; recorded on every point
flag_help.--no-sandbox: run the harness WITHOUT a mount namespace
flag_help.--work-root: where harness working trees live; must be OUTSIDE the platform
